sloka: धनानि व्यवसायेन विचीयन्ते महावने ।धातवो विविधाः च अपि मणि रत्न सुवर्णिनः ॥३-४३-३२॥
transliteration: dhanāni vyavasāyena vicīyante mahāvane ।dhātavo vividhāḥ ca api maṇi ratna suvarṇinaḥ ॥3-43-32॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana the essence of forest wealth is mineral wealth, which helps the growth of the treasury. It is conceived mentally as in the case of Venus.
